title: Standing Out for the Right Reason
summary: Өндөр нуруу нь аюул биш, давуу тал болсон Эдсоны түүх.

source.name: LIDA Stories
source.credit: Written by LIDA Portugal, illustrated by Sunniva Høiby-Øiset · LIDA Stories

changes: Images and audio removed; the picture-book pages were joined into paragraphs (one page per paragraph).

questions.prompt: What is the story mainly about?
options: A tall boy who finds safety and success in Portugal
A boy who becomes a soldier in Angola
A teacher who starts a basketball team in Angola
questions.explain: Эдсон Португалд очоод сагсан бөмбөгөөр амжилт гаргаж, одоо "trains refugee children" буюу бусдад тусалдаг болсон.

questions.prompt: Why did Edson's mother send him to Portugal?
options: She was afraid they would make him a soldier.
She wanted him to play basketball there.
His aunt needed help at home.
questions.explain: Хүүхдүүдийг цэрэгт татдаг хүмүүс түүн шиг хөвгүүдийг хайж байсан тул "His mother was afraid they would take him" гэж бичсэн.

questions.prompt: In "Because of his height he stood out", what does "stood out" mean?
questions.explain: "Because of his height he stood out" гэдэг нь Эдсон их өндөр болохоор бусдаас ялгарч, хүмүүс түүнийг амархан анзаардаг байсан гэсэн үг.
